messages:
leila: Quick note — followed the new SDK quickstart for embeddings and hit a couple copy/paste traps in sample-app README.

leila: The Python example in README still shows `client.embeddings.create(...)` and assumes single string input. New SDK expects `client.create_embeddings(model=..., inputs=[...])`.

jason: Oof, thanks. I missed that when we renamed the method last sprint. Small fix. Also saw the JS snippet uses `response.data[0].vector` which is wrong shape now. Should be `response.data[0].embedding`.

leila: Pasted error trace:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 7, in <module>
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model_name="embed-1", input="hi")
AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'embeddings'
```

jason: I'll open a tiny docs PR to update Python, JS, and Go snippets. Will add a one-liner migration note: "embeddings.* -> create_embeddings(... inputs=[...])".

leila: Also noticed the quickstart curl example sets `Content-Type: application/json` but uses top-level `input` instead of `inputs`. Small but confusing for copy/paste.

tess: Can we add a test that runs all readme codeblocks in CI? Would catch this earlier.

jason: Good call. I'll add a lightweight docs-smoke job that runs the Python and JS snippets with test creds (sandbox).

doc-bot: Created issue #910: "README codeblock parity: embeddings API change" and assigned to @jason.

leila: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/428 (updates examples + adds migration note). PTAL @tess

jason: Thanks, merging once smoke tests pass. :thumbsup:
